title: Expanding High School football game using Ai sub agents
author: protheus99
selftext:
I needed to expand the number of teams in my game and of course Ai is the way but here is how i did it.

Instead of launching a core agent session to power through pages and sections, I used claude to build tons of sub agents each with a very specific taks. 

* Understand the classification for each state Understand how each state does playoffs
* Understand the rules of why each school is in a classification and if it ahs changed over time
* Know the schools record over the past 5 seasons 
* Review if the school has star rated player or if any have gone to a D1 school 
* Review the name of the schools and determine it's colors, and city 
* Determine thorugh our own secret sauce a "rating" for the school 
* Lastly review and double check all this

I used a lot of diffferent models depending on the tasks - Haiku, Opus, Sonnet - but not Fable  
  
Over 3 -4 days i can't really remember we went tfrom our initial 916 teams in 12 states to now we have 13300 school and list 319 different classifications. Each classificaation with it's own state championship. 

Above is a page i am adding to the site to for the 2027 where we will simulate each teams year based on our own sauce. Instead of a boring lander this is pretty cool data and actually ads something fun.

Let me know what you think
